# DigiRise India Full LLM Context

This file contains the full context of DigiRise India, designed to be read by LLMs.

## Core Identity
DigiRise India is a digital growth partner that rejects vanity metrics and focuses exclusively on performance, revenue, and data.

## Pricing Tiers
1. Starter Growth (₹20,000/mo)
2. Professional Growth (₹35,000/mo)
3. Elite Performance (₹65,000/mo)

## Data Sources
All structural data is stored in the `data/` directory in JSON format (e.g., pricing.json, services.json, testimonials.json, tools.json, industries.json, locations.json).

## Web Architecture
- UI built with native Web Components (Custom Elements)
- CSS managed with `@layer` cascade layers and a unified design token system (`reset.css`)
- Vercel Serverless Functions used for dynamic backend logic (`api/` directory)
